The mechanism appears to involve the FcRn receptor as a central mediator, facilitating the interaction between the compound and the enzyme 3-oxoacyl-[acyl-carrier-protein] synthase 3. The evidence supports a potential role for the compound in modulating the activity of this enzyme through the FcRn receptor pathway, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
